contract: Environments: Config.EnvName() from the place id (Config.Env.Names; unknown = Dev), Config.StoreName(base): Dev keeps the name, Beta / Live append _Beta / _Live; DataService, Nickname, Grudge mail, the supporter list, the notification list and the ranking season use it. ServerErrorService: ScriptContext.Error and a Heartbeat over 0.5 s (not in the first 30 s) -> ONE analytics event 'ServerError' (value 1 / ms, fields script / message / kind), at most 5 a minute, digit runs cleaned, no player = record only; the last 50 kept (a run of the same finding = one row with a count) and merged into a DataStore document every 120 s and at the close; Studio's own _STUDIO copy; DebugCommand('Errors'[, 'stored' | 'live']). SwitchService: one document read every 60 s, only the listed switches (PassSales, Halloween, CrownWar, Goose), values cut to type / range, a switch not set = its default, a failed read keeps the last answer, GameState Switch<Key>, Changed signal; Halloween follows Config.Halloween.Enabled (never turns on a season the config has off), Goose starts no new goose, CrownWar counts no points and ends no round.
limitations: WarService / GooseService / the screen's [Buy] buttons are read through SwitchService.On: their hooks are checked as source (static), not run in this world. Real DataStore limits, ScriptContext and AnalyticsService are doubles; the analytics call is TelemetryService.Custom (pcall-wrapped). Moving old saves between environments is not done (Dev keeps the existing names) - see the ops doc.
